program_evidence.claim: 创建唯一新分类并保存ID
program_evidence.source:
def _a05_across_restart(args, recorder):
    first = common.launch_app(args.app_root, args.data_dir, 0)
    instance_dir = first.instance_dir
    target_name = _unique_category('a05restart')
    target_id = None
    record_id = None
    try:
        client = common.HttpClient(first.base_url)
        try:
            health = client.get('/api/health')
            recorder.expect_status(health, 200, aid='a05-restart-health-status')
            target_id = _create_category_json(
                client, recorder, 'a05-restart-target', target_name
            )

program_evidence.claim: 同instance_dir重启后按原分类ID读取实体
program_evidence.source:
second = common.launch_app(
        args.app_root, args.data_dir, 0, instance_dir=instance_dir
    )
    try:
        client = common.HttpClient(second.base_url)
        try:
            categories = _fetch_categories(
                client, recorder, 'a05-restart-categories'
            )
            target = _find_category_by_id(categories, target_id)
            recorder.check(
                'a05-restart-category-id',
                target is not None and _record_id(target) == target_id,
                f'重启后归类 {target_name!r} 的 id 保持 {target_id!r}',
